title: RepoEviAgent: Scalable Synthesis of Evidence-Grounded Repository-Level Question Answering Tasks
why_read: Relevant to anyone building or evaluating coding agents, offering a new benchmark grounded in real repository evidence.
analysis: This paper builds an automated pipeline that mines nearly 2.5 million pull requests from over 8,000 repositories to generate question-answering tasks that require understanding real code structure and history. The resulting benchmark, RepoEviQA, tests whether AI coding agents can answer questions using actual evidence from a repository rather than guessing. The authors evaluate several top coding models and find notable differences across programming languages and task types, which is useful signal for teams building code-understanding agents. It's a solid contribution to benchmark infrastructure though not a fundamental technical breakthrough itself.
